items.Sentence: A 1,500-gallon precast concrete septic tank with effluent filter will serve the MA residence.
A 13,000-gallon fiberglass septic tank with effluent filter will serve the entire Facility.
The 13,000 gallon septic tank will be equipped with duplex pumps and float switches that will be controlled and monitored by an adjacent pump control panel with visual and audible alarm.
The tasting room and hospitality building will be served by a 1,500-gallon kitchen grease interceptor, designed for a maximum flow of 500 gpd and a 3-day retention time.
A wastewater treatment system, consisting of an Advantex recirculating aerobic biological filter system, will be installed to provide secondary level treatment for the domestic wastewater flow.

The filter unit, also referred to as a treatment pod, is a manufacturer- supplied modular unit consisting of a fiberglass tank containing textile filtration media, a pressurized influent distribution pipe network, and an underdrain to collect treated wastewater.
The treatment system consists of one filter unit, a recirculation tank, dosing tank, piping, pumps, and controls.
